parsed.notes:
The candidate qualifications default to required; the Nice to Have heading makes its items optional. Responsibilities and company descriptions are excluded.
The named programming languages are individually labeled despite being examples of acceptable alternatives.
ML inference infrastructure is mapped to model-serving, not to the broader AI infrastructure skill.
Technical design, generic automation, and operational-data analysis are read literally rather than expanded to software architecture, workflow automation, or observability.
The 2+ years minimum is provisionally junior under the guide's 0–2-year range, but flagged because the open-ended range does not establish an upper bound.
The unspecified degree level maps to bachelor; practical experience is explicitly accepted instead.
